/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from werkzeug.sansio.multipart import MultipartDecoder, Data, Epilogue, NeedData
b=b'063afc4cbe46a740590988143971e2bd'
prefix=(b'--'+b+b'\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"f\"; filename=\"x\"\\r\\n\\r\\n')
payload=b'\\0'*(65536-len(prefix)-1)
body=prefix+payload+b'\\r\\n--'+b+b'--\\r\\n'
d=MultipartDecoder(b)
out=b''
for chunk in (body[:65536], body[65536:], None):
    d.receive_data(chunk)
    while True:
        ev=d.next_event()
        if isinstance(ev, Data):
            out += ev.data
        if isinstance(ev, (NeedData, Epilogue)):
            break
print(len(payload), len(out), out.endswith(b'\\r'), out == payload)
PY"
